Update the initial proposal screen copy to use a fixed greeting and fixed message text (no user-editable fields): change the greeting to exactly “Hey Bhoomi,” and insert the following message text immediately before the “Will you be my Valentine?” question:

ni tu ikk vaari keh de ke,
"mai teri aan"
dekhin,'taarun kiven mull tere pyar da
Remove the personalization UI and related state so the page no longer shows any fields such as “Her Name”, “Personal Message”, or “Affirmation”, and the proposal uses only the fixed copy.
Remove background music functionality and UI from the page (including playback controls), so nothing related to music appears in either the initial or success screens.
Remove the girlfriend corner photo from the UI so no personal photo/picture is displayed on either the initial or success screens.
